# E10: Edakkal and other rock art

**Window:** Undated or broadly attributed panels; do not assign all figures to 6000 BCE.

**Question:** Which marks belong to which phases, and how can their ages be constrained?

## Evidence presently available in this seed

A tourism page makes the 6000 BCE claim. The scholarly discussion inspected does not establish that date as a secure absolute date for the engravings.

Source routes: [S011](../sources/S011.md), [S012](../sources/S012.md), [S013](../sources/S013.md).

## What this does not establish

This is not proof that a particular proposed early date is false. Nearby celts, later inscriptions, stylistic parallels and superimposition provide different types of information. Interpretations of figures and beliefs must remain attributed.

## Research tasks

- [ ] Create panel- and motif-level records with survey provenance.
- [ ] Separate engravings from inscriptions and document their physical relationships.
- [ ] Review direct dating claims and associated-context dating critically.
- [ ] Record local knowledge and later documentation history without declaring colonial documentation the first awareness of the site.
